descricao_original: Active cells have abundant mitochondria. In this toluidine blue-stained section of liver, mitochondria appear as small dots or irregular shapes that are just barely visible with the light microscope. 1000x

bases.legenda_ia: Imagem-base educacional de histologia da pagina 'Mitochondria', no setor Células > Estruturas > Mitochondria > Mitochondria 2. Descricao original da pagina: Active cells have abundant mitochondria. In this toluidine blue-stained section of liver, mitochondria appear as small dots or irregular shapes that are just barely visible with the light microscope. 1000x. Este arquivo nao contem os marcadores interativos; use as camadas PNG relacionadas para localizar estruturas.
